title: prefill-decode-stage-overlap-chunked-speculative-kv-kernel-scheduler-optimizations
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: reduce end-to-end latency and GPU waste on short and medium-length requests by improving overlap between prefill and decode stages, enabling chunked and speculative prefill paths, and making kernel scheduling aware of KV cache locality and continuous batching windows. This PR implements a coordinated set of runtime changes that collectively reduce P50/P95 token latency and increase throughput under mixed workloads.

What changed: consolidated under a runtime flag --prefill-overlap=auto (off by default for older deployments) the following behaviors: 1) Chunked prefill: break long prefill sequences into configurable chunks to allow earlier decode progress for streaming clients and to reduce peak memory/KV pressure. 2) Speculative prefill: when decode demand is detected for a previously-prefilled prefix, spawn speculative decode work using available kernels to warm KV caches and amortize scheduling latency. 3) Stage overlap scheduler: a new kernel-level scheduler that opportunistically schedules prefills and decodes on the same GPU with a priority/credit system to maintain latency SLOs while increasing utilization. 4) KV cache locality hints: expose lightweight hints from the prefill pipeline to the kernel scheduler to favor reusing warmed KV shards on the same device, reducing remote fetches. 5) Continuous batching improvements: align prefill chunk boundaries with batching windows to reduce small-batch overhead and improve packing.

Implementation notes: changes touch the following subsystems: runtime/scheduler (new overlap scheduler and priority credits), runtime/prefill (chunking and speculative orchestration), runtime/kvcache (locality hint API + metrics), kernels/{cuda,metal} (minor APIs to accept locality and speculative tags), and the continuous-batching path in runtime/batching. The PR includes feature flags and a staged rollout path: the new scheduler is guarded by a runtime config and can be disabled per-pool. We added robust telemetry (latency/throughput breakdown per-stage, KV hit/miss by locality, speculative decode waste) and safety limits (max speculative inflight per-GPU, max chunk size, and backoff on tail latency regression).

Benchmarks: internal end-to-end benchmarks run on r4d-like instances show P50 token latency improvement of ~12% and P95 improvement of ~8% for mixed prompt lengths (8-512 tokens) with a throughput uplift of ~9% for steady-state generation. Short-tail, low-seq requests saw a 15% reduction in observed cold-decode latency thanks to speculative warming. We observed a small increase in total token compute (~2-3%) due to speculation but significant unit-cost savings from better packing and fewer remote KV transfers.

Compatibility and rollout: default behavior is unchanged. Ops can enable --prefill-overlap=auto per-pool after validating on canary hosts. The PR also includes an observability dashboard and an integration test suite for deterministic scheduling scenarios.

Related: builds on previous prefill/decode stage-overlap work (see PRs pr-84654, pr-86147, pr-89123) and closes the Linear tasks ENG-2123 (prefill overlap design) and ENG-2190 (kernel scheduler extension).
commits_summary: feat(runtime): add overlap scheduler with credit-based prioritization (aisha)
feat(prefill): support chunked prefill with configurable chunk size and alignment (aisha)
feat(prefill): speculative decode orchestration and safety limits (aisha)
perf(kvcache): add locality hint API and metrics (marcus)
chore(kernels): accept speculative/locality tags in launch metadata (sofia)
tests: add integration scenarios for overlap scheduling and speculative warmups (ethan)
review_comments: Marcus Lee: Can the speculative decode path be limited per-customer to avoid wasted charge on bursty tenants? Reply: added per-tenant max_speculative_inflight with default 0 and ops-exposed override (aisha).

Sofia Hernandez: The chunker boundary alignment looked like it could mis-align with tokenizers that output very long tokens. Suggest adding a max-chunk-in-tokens guard. Reply: added max_chunk_tokens and a tokenizer-agnostic fallback (aisha).
Ethan Brooks: CI flake in kernels/cuda/launcher.cu on first run. Action: fixed a race in host->device metadata copy and added deterministic unit tests (sofia).
Marcus Lee (approve): Verified P95 regressions not observed on canary for 72h. Approving for merge.
release_notes: Runtime: opt-in prefill-decode stage overlap. Adds chunked and speculative prefill paths, KV cache locality hints, and a new overlap scheduler. Opt-in via --prefill-overlap=auto; disabled by default. See ops docs for rollout guidance and metrics.
notes_for_ops: Canary for 24-72h on low-traffic pool before fleet-wide rollout
Start with max_chunk_tokens=256 and max_speculative_inflight=0, then gradually enable speculative paths per-pool
Monitor dashboards/prefill_overlap and metrics: prefills.speculative_wasted_tokens, scheduler.locality_hits, batching.packed_batches_ratio
